search_scope: Two targeted web-search queries for ASR/Kreiss-Tomkins polling and AlaskaBeacon/AlaskaPublicMedia/ADN coverage; no auth, bypass, or retry. Results did not return direct regional original polling coverage. ADN was reported blocked by robots in search; Alaska Beacon normal search GET returned 403. Alaska Public Media search pages were fetched normally.

methodology_findings_secondary_attributi.source: Search result citing ASR social post
methodology_findings_secondary_attributi.reported: Oct 1–3, 2026; n=1,512 likely voters; weighted MOE ±3.0%; text-to-online plus ASR Survey Panel.
methodology_findings_secondary_attributi.status: Secondary transcription of a pollster social item; original ASR post/toplines/interview was not retrieved. Treat wording and method as not independently source-verified.

methodology_findings_secondary_attributi.source: On Point Politics Alaska gubernatorial poll page
methodology_findings_secondary_attributi.reported: ASR row lists 54–46 for Kreiss-Tomkins vs Wilson as 'Super F' (Oct 3, n=1,512 LV).
methodology_findings_secondary_attributi.status: Aggregator labeling; does not establish whether this was a separately worded head-to-head question or the poll's RCV final round.

methodology_findings_secondary_attributi.source: Wikipedia poll-table transcription; also repeated by search results from Call the Map and RealClearPolitics
methodology_findings_secondary_attributi.reported: The table separates first-choice/rounds: first-choice KJT 48, Wilson 27, Bronson 15, Taylor 10; round 2 KJT 50, Wilson 30, Bronson 20; round 3 KJT 54, Wilson 46. Thus 54–46 is represented as the third/final RCV round, not a result to substitute for the initial four-candidate choice.
methodology_findings_secondary_attributi.status: Secondary transcriptions agree on the distinction, but no original questionnaire/report was obtained to verify exact prompt, rankings collected, transfer rules, or whether 54–46 was independently asked.

regional_publisher_checks.finding: Captured search results surfaced a Taylor withdrawal story, not ASR poll coverage or pollster interview. This bounded site search does not prove no such story exists.

regional_publisher_checks.status: Search tool reported adn.com blocked by robots.txt; no GET attempted.

bottom_line: Secondary tables clarify representation: 48/27/15/10 is the first-choice field and 54/46 appears as the third/final RCV round. Original ASR questionnaire, exact wording, collection/weighting details, and regional-publisher attribution remain unverified. Do not treat the two rows as competing poll results or use the governor poll as a Senate poll.
